headline.purpose: Page titles and major identity headings.

metadata.purpose: Dates, labels, numbering, and structural context.

components.name: Active Rail Link
components.description: Plain text navigation with a narrow blue state rule.
components.css: .ds-rail-link { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 27px; align-items: center; padding-left: 13px; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); font: 15px/1.3 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-rail-link.is-active { color: var(--accent, #2200ff); } .ds-rail-link.is-active::before { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 2px; height: 12px; background: currentColor; content: ''; } .ds-rail-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2200ff); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Mobile Menu Control
components.description: Literal text control with no pill, icon, or shadow.
components.css: .ds-menu-control { min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #0b0b0b); background: var(--page, #f7f6f5); font: 15px/1 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-control:hover { color: var(--accent, #2200ff); } .ds-menu-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2200ff); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-menu-control:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Domain Directory Row
components.description: Number, title, and arrow aligned by a single structural rule.
components.css: .ds-domain-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 64px 1fr 32px; min-height: 84px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06); color: #0b0b0b; font: 15px/1.3 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; gap: 16px; } .ds-domain-row strong { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-domain-row:hover { color: #2200ff; border-color: rgba(0,0,0,.24); } .ds-domain-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2200ff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Dither Signature Mark
components.description: Small native identity mark derived from the Home entrance.
components.css: .ds-dither-mark { display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; color: #0b0b0b; background: radial-gradient(circle at 2px 2px, currentColor 0 1.15px, transparent 1.3px) 0 0 / 5px 5px, radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, currentColor 0 .65px, transparent .8px) 2px 2px / 4px 4px; clip-path: polygon(16% 0,68% 0,100% 31%,100% 84%,84% 100%,32% 100%,0 68%,0 16%); }

narrative.overview: The site pairs a single expressive opening gesture with a disciplined editorial body. The Home-only dithered name establishes authorship; everything after it earns trust through warm paper, exact grid alignment, serif reading texture, and very limited color.
keyCharacteristics: One high-expression entrance, followed by quiet reading surfaces.
Cognition-like structural discipline implemented with Theodore's own content and mark.
Warm white, near-black, hairline rules, and rare signal blue.
No decorative modules that compete with the writing.

rules.name: The Rare Blue Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue identifies state; it never becomes a large background fill.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sans establishes structure; serif carries narrative. Do not introduce a third personality font.

rules.name: The Flat Authority Rule
rules.body: If an element needs a shadow to appear important, its hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Do preserve every published sentence, route, metadata field, alt text, ARIA label, and content order.
Do use whitespace and real content boundaries before adding any new visual element.
Do keep the entrance interaction interruptible, idle-aware, and fully static under reduced motion.
Do verify 1440px, 1024px, 390px, and 320px layouts before release.
donts: Don't restore the deep-blue star field, glass navigation, Shantell UI typography, or Three.js background.
Don't add pill navigation, bento cards, scroll reveals, parallax, or GSAP storytelling.
Don't copy Cognition's logo, client material, CSS, font files, or source code.
Don't add visible interface copy beyond the approved Menu and Close controls.
